en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, and Muawiya Bin Ammar, and Hafs Bin Al Bakhtary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>

having said regarding the man who emancipated the owned slave. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic would emancipate for every organ of his, an organ (of his) from the Fire’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And it is recommended for the man that he gets closer to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> on the evening of Arafaat, and the day of Arafaat, by the emancipation, and the charity’.
